parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. On the Overview page in the IoT Platform console, view the ID of the current instance.

<notice>
If an ID value is displayed, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no <props="intl"><ph>Overview page or </ph></props>ID value is displayed, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The array of sub-devices to be mounted on the target gateway device. The value is a JSON string that contains the identity information of sub-devices. You can use ProductKey and DeviceName or IotId to identify a device. Example: [{"productKey":"a1BwAGxxx","deviceName":"device1"},{"IotId":"Q7uOhxxx"}]
parameters.help_zh: 要挂载在目标网关设备上的子设备数组，为JSON字符串形式的子设备标识信息，可使用ProductKey和DeviceName或IotId指代设备，例如[{"productKey":"a1BwAGxxx","deviceName":"device1"},{"IotId":"Q7uOhxxx"}]
parameters.name: device_list_str

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the gateway device. The ID is issued by IoT Platform and is the unique identifier of the device.
If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify ProductKey and DeviceName. IotId is the unique identifier of a device and corresponds to a combination of ProductKey and DeviceName. If you specify both IotId and the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName, IotId takes precedence
parameters.help_zh:
网关设备ID。物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。
如果传入该参数，则无需传入ProductKey和DeviceName。IotId作为设备唯一标识符，和ProductKey与DeviceName组合是一一对应的关系。如果您同时传入IotId和ProductKey与DeviceName组合，则以IotId为准
parameters.name: gw_iot_id

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the gateway device belongs.
If you specify this parameter, you must also specify DeviceName
parameters.help_zh:
网关设备所隶属的产品ProductKey。
如果传入该参数，需同时传入DeviceName
parameters.name: gw_product_key

parameters.help_en:
The device name of the gateway device.
If you specify this parameter, you must also specify ProductKey
parameters.help_zh:
网关设备名称。
如果传入该参数，需同时传入ProductKey
parameters.name: gw_device_name
